featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: Extremely Disappointed with Amazon Courier Service and Customer Support

I am writing this review after facing a very frustrating and disappointing experience with Amazon’s courier service and their customer support team. I had placed an important order that was supposed to be delivered within the given time frame. However, without any prior call, message, or even a simple notification, the courier service cancelled my parcel and marked it as “delivery attempt failed.”

This is completely unacceptable. The delivery person never called me, never visited my address, and yet updated the status as if I was unavailable. I was waiting the entire day for my delivery, checking the tracking details repeatedly, hoping it would arrive. But suddenly, the order status changed to “undeliverable – returning to seller.”

When I contacted Amazon’s customer support and delivery helpline, I expected some genuine help or at least clear communication. Unfortunately, the support team was completely unhelpful and careless. They just kept repeating scripted answers like “we’re sorry for the inconvenience” and “please wait 24–48 hours.” No one took any real action or tried to contact the delivery agent or courier hub to resolve the issue.

It is very disappointing to see such poor service from a company as big as Amazon. There was no accountability, no communication, and no professionalism. The courier executive’s behavior was irresponsible, and the call support team failed to provide any real assistance.

If a customer’s parcel can be cancelled or returned without even a single call or message, then what is the point of providing contact details? It wastes time, causes stress, and makes customers lose trust in the service.

I sincerely hope Amazon looks into such incidents and takes strict action against delivery agents and support staff who fail to perform their duties properly. Customers deserve proper communication, transparency, and respect — not false delivery updates and unhelpful responses.

Overall Experience: 1/5

Delivery Experience: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (No call or attempt made)

Customer Support: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (Completely unhelpful)

Communication: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (No update or message before cancelling parcel)

I expect Amazon to improve its courier process and train its support executives to actually listen and resolve issues — not just apologize and disconnect.
